Subject: MAP & Eval Asset Exchange — ACME pilot (prompt packs + test cases)

Hi Elena / ACME legal team,

Following up from last week’s call — attached is our draft MAP (MAP_DRAFT_v0.3.xlsx) and a small sample prompt pack and manifest to illustrate how we’d ingest testcases into the sandbox. High-level asks and proposed constraints below: 

- Timeline: mutual milestone-based MAP with final acceptance by 2026-06-15. Proposed checkpoints: asset handoff (5/06), sandbox seed access (5/10), evaluation run (5/24), acceptance review (6/02).
- Usage constraints (critical): evaluation-only license; no redistribution outside ACME evaluation team; retention limited to 90 days after acceptance or 30 days after pilot termination (whichever earlier); no derivative dataset publication without explicit written consent.
- Security/evidence: we can provide SOC 2 Type II reports and an access-only sandbox with tokenized logs. If you require escrow for the dataset, we can coordinate with a third-party (cc’ing Tom from Data Escrow).
- Acceptance criteria: pass 3 core testcases (as listed in testcases_manifest.csv) at >92% success for intent and safety guardrails.
- Deliverables I’m attaching: MAP draft, prompt-pack-sample.zip (contains 25 canonical prompts), and testcases_manifest.csv.

Please let us know any legal redlines up front so we can route to our contracts team. If ACME agrees to the constraints above we’ll prepare the final MAP and a Docusign packet.

Next steps: Elena — can you confirm (a) whether an escrow is required, (b) if your legal team needs a 3rd-party MPA, and (c) the internal list of people who will receive the sandbox credentials?

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez

Thanks everyone — summary and agreed next steps below (I’ve attached MAP_FINAL_ACME_20260506.xlsx which integrates the retention wording and escrow step):

1) Escrow: ACME confirmed they want escrow. Tom (Data Escrow) will provide access options: encrypted escrow with customer-managed key (preferred) or provider-managed key. Tom — please send a brief quote and handshake SLA by 5/08.
2) Retention & deletion workflow: Redwood will schedule automated deletion 90 days after acceptance; once deletion runs, we will send a signed deletion receipt (screenshot + timestamp + operator id) to ACME legal and place the proof in the HubSpot deal record.
3) Sandbox: Redwood to provision a restricted sandbox for 6 ACME users on 5/10 (read/write limits; no egress except to our controlled test harness). Credentials will be ephemeral tokens rotated every 24 hours during the active eval window.
4) Acceptance criteria & testcases: we will seed the 25 prompt archetypes and the testcases_manifest.csv on 5/10. ACME will run evaluation window 5/24–5/28. If ACME hits the acceptance thresholds we will execute final acceptance and begin retention countdown.
5) Legal/docusign: I’ve initiated a Docusign packet (link included) for the MAP + MPA redlines. Expected sign-off target: 5/12.
